transcript:
Agent: Hello, this is Priya from Sunrise Finance. Am I speaking with Anita Rao?
Caller: Yes, this is Anita.
Agent: Your instalment of Rs 4,500 was due on 15 October. Can you pay today?
Caller: I thought I paid it. Can you check reference LN-20931?
Agent: I see a payment of Rs 4,500 received on 16 October against LN-20931. It is cleared.
Caller: Okay, thank you.

Agent: I'm calling about the renewal of policy HP-558210, which expires on 30 November.
Caller: Yes, I want to renew.
Agent: The premium is Rs 12,400. I can renew it now using your saved card.
Caller: Go ahead.
Agent: Done. Your policy is now renewed.
Caller: Great, thanks.

Caller: This is the third time I am calling about a wrong charge. I was charged Rs 750 twice.
Agent: I am sorry. Can I have your account reference?
Caller: It is AC-44019. My name is Sunil Mehta.
Agent: I can see both charges but I cannot reverse one from here. A specialist team must review it.
Caller: So nothing is fixed today? This is unacceptable.
Agent: I have raised a complaint. You will get an update within 5 working days.

Agent: Hello, am I speaking with Meena Iyer? I'm calling about your overdue instalment.
Caller: I'm driving. Can you call me back after 6 in the evening?
Agent: Sure, I will call you back at 6 pm.
Caller: Okay, bye.

Agent: Hello, this is Sunrise Finance. I'm calling about Rs 2,300 due on 20 October.
Caller: Yes, I wanted to ask about the late fee.
Agent: The late fee is Rs 150. If you pay by
[call disconnected]

Agent: Hello?
Caller: ...
Agent: Hello, can you hear me?
[silence]
[call disconnected]

Agent: Mr Khan, your payment of Rs 8,200 for loan LN-70412 has been overdue since 5 October.
Caller: I will try to arrange it this week, maybe.
Agent: Can I note a promise to pay by Friday?
Caller: I can't promise anything. Let's see.

Agent: Namaste, Sunrise Finance se Priya bol rahi hoon. Kya main Rajesh Nair se baat kar rahi hoon?
Caller: Haan ji, boliye.
Agent: Aapki Rs 3,100 ki kist 12 October ko due thi.
Caller: Maine kal hi online bhar di hai, reference number TXN-90817 hai.
Agent: Theek hai, mujhe payment dikh rahi hai. Dhanyavad.

Caller: I want to know the renewal cost for my health policy.
Agent: May I have your policy number?
Caller: I don't have it with me right now.
Agent: Without it I cannot find the policy. Please call back with the number.
Caller: Okay, I'll call back later.

Agent: I'm calling about Rs 5,600 due on 8 October on account AC-30177.
Caller: Yes, I can pay it right now over the phone.
Agent: Great, I'll take your card details.
Caller: Actually, wait. My card is in the other room. Never mind, I'll call you back tomorrow.
Agent: Okay, we'll note that.

Caller: My statement shows a Rs 300 fee I didn't expect.
Agent: Let me check. Can I have your name?
Caller: Farah Siddiqui.
Agent: Ms Siddiqui, the fee was applied in error. I have reversed Rs 300 and the reference is RV-2208.
Caller: Thank you, that's all I needed.

Caller: What are your branch timings on Saturday?
Agent: Our branch is open from 10 am to 2 pm on Saturday.
Caller: Thanks, that helps.

Agent: Mr Dutta, you owe Rs 9,000: Rs 6,000 due on 1 October and Rs 3,000 due on 1 September.
Caller: I can pay Rs 3,000 today and the rest on 20 November.
Agent: I'll note a part payment of Rs 3,000 today and Rs 6,000 on 20 November. The reference is PP-5512.
Caller: Fine.
